main.description: A segment's leaderboard: each athlete's fastest ranked effort that the viewer may see, fastest first. Only active segments have one; any other status has no entries. An effort is ranked unless its athlete hides from leaderboards, its activity is excluded, or its average speed is above its sport group's cap. Each board ranks only one type's efforts: the activity's sport, or eBike for e-bike rides.

period.description: By the effort's local date, against the AppView's current calendar year or month in UTC.

scope.description: following: only the viewer and the athletes they effectively follow. Needs a signed-in viewer.

board.description: The board type: the activity's sport, or eBike for e-bike and e-mountain-bike rides. Absent means the listed type with the most efforts.

ageGroup.description: Only athletes in this age group (actor.leaderboardBrackets). Absent means every age, and athletes without brackets.

weightClass.description: Only athletes in this weight class, in kilograms (actor.leaderboardBrackets).

board.description: The board type served; absent when the segment has none to list.

boards.description: The board types with ranked efforts on the segment the viewer may see, over all time and whatever the period, scope and brackets, most efforts first, ties by token; a requested type is listed even with none.

viewer.description: The signed-in viewer's own entry, whichever page this is; absent when they aren't on the board.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: The segment isn't indexed, or isn't served (as for getSegment).

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: An unknown period, board, scope, age group, weight class or gender, or the following scope without a signed-in viewer.
